headline: Turn custom ESPHome firmware into live Home Assistant devices
intro: Build devices from YAML with ESPHome, then connect them to Home Assistant through the native API. Sensors, buttons, and other configured components send updates over a persistent connection, while an ESPHome device can also extend Bluetooth, infrared, radio frequency, or serial access around your home.
highlights: Expose entities from your ESPHome device configuration
Receive state changes over a persistent native API connection
Use ESPHome devices as Bluetooth, infrared, radio, and serial proxies
